items.title: Five lifespan-extending treatments boost the same antioxidant in mice
items.text: Aging is about far more than wrinkles and gray hair, despite what social media and advertisements might have us believe. The real concern lies beneath the surface, where the biology of aging is intertwined with a host of diseases, from heart disease to neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's to metabolic disorders and cancer. Targeting the processes that make the body age could have effects far beyond any single disease, potentially easing the burden of several age-related conditions at once.
